boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: A walkable set of named Stuart Collection outdoor artworks on the UC San Diego campus; the collection states that admission is free.

cards.title: Meet at Sun God Lawn
cards.subtitle: Stuart Collection, between the Faculty Club and Mandeville Auditorium
cards.notes: Bring a friend and use the lawn beneath this colorful outdoor sculpture as a clear campus meetup point before a walk.
cards.short_summary: A vivid, named outdoor sculpture with room to pause nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stuart Collection identifies Sun God as a sculpture on Sun God Lawn and states that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Sun God — Stuart Collection, UC San Diego
cards.access_notes: Outdoor artwork. No admission is required; campus parking may carry a separate charge.

cards.title: Walk past Two Running Violet V Forms
cards.subtitle: Stuart Collection, UC San Diego campus
cards.notes: Make this pair of violet forms a stop on a self-guided art walk, then compare the changing view as you circle it.
cards.short_summary: A named Robert Irwin work for a short outdoor art stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stuart Collection lists Two Running Violet V Forms as a named work in its UC San Diego collection, whose admission is free.
cards.source_title: Two Running Violet V Forms — Stuart Collection, UC San Diego
cards.access_notes: Outdoor artwork. No admission is required; campus parking may carry a separate charge.

cards.title: Pause at La Jolla Project
cards.subtitle: Stuart Collection, UC San Diego campus
cards.notes: Use the artwork as a deliberate pause in a campus loop; listen to its related Inscape audio-tour segment on your phone.
cards.short_summary: A named collection work paired with a free online audio-tour experience.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stuart Collection includes La Jolla Project in its Inscape audio tour and identifies the collection as free to visit.
cards.source_title: Inscape: Art and Mindfulness at the Stuart Collection
cards.access_notes: Outdoor artwork and online audio tour. No admission is required; campus parking may carry a separate charge.

cards.title: Slow down at Trees
cards.subtitle: Stuart Collection, UC San Diego campus
cards.notes: Add Trees to a low-key outdoor art loop and try the matching Inscape audio segment for a guided moment of attention.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor artwork with an optional mindfulness audio pairing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stuart Collection lists Trees in its Inscape audio tour and states that admission to the collection is free.
cards.source_title: Inscape: Art and Mindfulness at the Stuart Collection
cards.access_notes: Outdoor artwork and online audio tour. No admission is required; campus parking may carry a separate charge.

cards.title: Find Something Pacific
cards.subtitle: Stuart Collection, UC San Diego campus

cards.evidence_claim: The Stuart Collection includes Something Pacific in its Inscape audio tour and states that collection admission is free.

cards.short_summary: An outdoor art stop suited to a self-guided campus loop.

cards.title: Walk Snake Path to Geisel
cards.subtitle: Stuart Collection, approach to Geisel Library
cards.notes: Follow the 560-foot slate serpent path with a friend, noticing its garden, bench, and carved-book elements on the way.
cards.short_summary: A functional, named art path leading toward Geisel Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego describes Snake Path as a 560-foot footpath in the Stuart Collection; collection admission is free.
cards.source_title: Snake Path — Stuart Collection, UC San Diego
cards.access_notes: Outdoor footpath artwork. No admission is required; campus parking may carry a separate charge.

cards.title: Read Green Table together
cards.subtitle: Stuart Collection, UC San Diego campus
cards.notes: Pause at this named artwork and read its inscribed text together, then continue the collection walk at an unhurried pace.
cards.short_summary: A text-based sculpture that supports a conversational stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stuart Collection identifies Green Table as a named collection work, and its published visitor material states that admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor artwork. No admission is required; campus parking may carry a separate charge.

cards.title: Find the Red Shoe
cards.subtitle: Stuart Collection, UC San Diego campus
cards.notes: Add this oversized, named work to a daytime art walk and use it as an easy photo-and-conversation stop with friends.
cards.short_summary: A distinctly recognizable outdoor sculpture in the campus collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stuart Collection identifies Red Shoe as a named collection work, and its published visitor material states that admission is free.
